newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire up 6.66 pct, leads early gainers.
newsitem.headline: Empire up 6.66 pct, leads early gainers.

text.p: Empire East Land Holdings Inc rose 6.66 percent in early trade on Monday as short-term players bought the shares amid a directionless market, brokers said.
"Some punters have gone back to Empire since there's no definitive trend in the market yet," one broker said.
Real estate developer Empire has been the subject of speculative trading after being hammered down early this year following widespread fears of an overheated property sector.
Empire has been ranging between 4.0 and 4.80 pesos in recent weeks.
On Monday, it was the mostly heavily traded issue with more than 2.3 billion shares changing hands after one hour.
